pr: 1 of 3 (U0 HUD half, U1, U2) commit 545887f vs origin/main
evaluated_from: committed diff and executor-reported evidence (make test exit 0, ship-ui 149/0, red-first parse error on main); nothing re-run

tests_pass.note: executor-reported full make test green; red-first shown; not re-run

lint_clean.note: lint-precision allowlist row removed with the 1.0-beta fallback; not re-run

acceptance_criteria.note: AC1, AC2, AC3, AC7 table parity, AC11 covered by real assertions; AC3 centre-third rule is checked for the card column only, and the D-41 interlude card (acknowledged deviation) covers the centre

code_quality.note: ShipHud is clean, fake-clock (advance(dt) only, no wall-clock read); demo is dense one-line style; source-tag seam untested in PR 1

documentation.note: changelog, execution notes, sprint Progress, JSON all updated; Progress and JSON honest about deferrals

design_fidelity.note: HUD informs, display controls instant, D-12 clocks same size (CLOCK_SIZE shared), no 1.0 - beta; interim Decisions block in Tab and live N/L/C/M keys are the declared PR 1 to PR 2 staging

findings.issue: AC3 'never over the centre third' is asserted only for the card column geometry (cards_clear_centre). The D-41 interlude card (about 825 px wide at 1280x720, x 25..850) does cover the centre third; Execution note 2 accepts this but no test or design-doc AC edit records the exemption.
findings.suggestion: Amend AC3 in the design doc to name the interlude exemption, and add a test that the interlude card never overlaps the status strip or the column.

findings.issue: The tour_interlude frame is internally inconsistent: strip shows 0.0042c, ship +0 s, 'Phase boosting', while the interlude card reads 0.986466c, gamma 6.1. The test injects a CardInterlude over a fresh leg, so it is not a real cruise state. The frame is evidence of the layout only, not of the strip in cruise.
findings.suggestion: Capture the interlude from a real cruise (drive journey_tick to the cruise phase) so strip and card agree, or label the frame as layout-only.

findings.issue: The source-tagged record seam (record_sent, sent_log, intent_source) has no test in PR 1, although the plan lists it under U0. Its default rule (intents present means player) and one-shot reset are unverified until test_no_twitch lands.
findings.suggestion: Add a small unit check now (default tagging, one-shot reset, tour and tick tags) or confirm it is the first test in PR 2.

findings.issue: speed_text clamps digits to 9 and formats float64 beta with %.9f, so one_minus_beta below 1e-9 shows 1.000000000c. When one_minus_beta is absent the fallback prints raw beta.
findings.suggestion: Cover a near-c case with a test (omb 1e-12) and state the intended display.

findings.issue: The interim 'Decisions' block in Tab and live M/N/L/C keys mean decisions are still available from display controls through PR 1. Declared in Execution notes and the plan, so not a failure, but the HUD is not 'information only' until PR 2.
findings.suggestion: Keep PR 2 blocking on removal; ensure ship-ui-test table rows for N/L/C/M are updated in the same PR.

findings.issue: Notice cards are titled just 'Ship' in the renders; chips collapse to a bare title with no one-line summary.
findings.suggestion: Use a descriptive title or put the first line of the body in the chip.

deferred_ok: consoles, test_ship_consoles, test_no_twitch, dwell label, N/L/C/M removal (PR 2)
summary: PR 1 delivers a real ShipHud with strong, specific tests: strip checked in nine scene states against formatted sim fields, digit-free captions, DisplayBinding audit, equal clock sizes, speed from one_minus_beta, card triggers and expiry on a fake clock, priority and two-expanded, and control table parity both ways. Dev gating is tested through key events. The 1.0 - beta fallback is removed. Weak spots: the centre-third rule is tested only for the column (interlude exempt but undocumented in the ACs), the interlude render is a staged inconsistent state, and the record seam has no test yet. Deferrals are legitimate and honestly recorded.
